entries.source: তথ্য যা সংগ্রহ করা হতে পারে

Account তৈরি করলে Aponar Nihon আপনার email address, account name এবং authentication identifier সংরক্ষণ করে। আপনি চাইলে profile-এ school/institution, nationality, city, phone number, JLPT target, preferred language, study goal, bio এবং profile photo URL যোগ করতে পারেন।
entries.target: Kapag gumawa ka ng account, iniimbak ng Aponar Nihon ang iyong email address, account name at authentication identifier. Kung gusto mo, maaari kang magdagdag sa profile ng school/institution, nationality, city, phone number, JLPT target, preferred language, study goal, bio at profile photo URL.

entries.source: Signed-in অবস্থায় learning activity যেমন visited section/page, selected learning actions, progress এবং activity timestamps সংরক্ষণ করা হতে পারে, যাতে student dashboard ও admin learning analytics কাজ করে। Password Aponar Nihon database-এ plain text হিসেবে সংরক্ষণ করা হয় না; authentication Supabase Auth দ্বারা পরিচালিত হয়।
entries.target: Habang naka-sign in, maaaring iimbak ang learning activity gaya ng binisitang section/page, mga piniling learning action, progress at activity timestamp, para gumana ang student dashboard at admin learning analytics. Hindi iniimbak ang password sa Aponar Nihon database bilang plain text; ang authentication ay pinamamahalaan ng Supabase Auth.

entries.source: CV Builder-এর resume content এবং Student Toolkit-এর part-time/time-management data browser local storage-এ রাখার জন্য design করা হয়েছে এবং Aponar Nihon learning-activity system ইচ্ছাকৃতভাবে CV-এর personal field content সংগ্রহ করে না। Page usage/activity event আলাদাভাবে log হতে পারে.
entries.target: Ang resume content ng CV Builder at ang part-time/time-management data ng Student Toolkit ay idinisenyo para manatili sa browser local storage, at sadyang hindi kinokolekta ng Aponar Nihon learning-activity system ang laman ng personal field ng CV. Maaaring hiwalay na ma-log ang page usage/activity event.

entries.source: Account login, profile, learning progress, study history, security, support, service improvement এবং student-facing/admin learning analytics-এর জন্য data ব্যবহার করা হয়। আমরা advertising profile তৈরি বা user data বিক্রি করি না।
entries.target: Ginagamit ang data para sa account login, profile, learning progress, study history, security, support, service improvement at student-facing/admin learning analytics. Hindi kami gumagawa ng advertising profile o nagbebenta ng user data.

entries.source: Aponar Nihon account, authentication এবং database-এর জন্য Supabase ব্যবহার করে। প্রয়োজনীয় data এই service provider-এর infrastructure-এ process হতে পারে।
entries.target: Gumagamit ang Aponar Nihon ng Supabase para sa account, authentication at database. Maaaring iproseso ang kinakailangang data sa infrastructure ng service provider na ito.

entries.source: Account active থাকা পর্যন্ত account-related data রাখা হতে পারে। User account delete করলে Aponar Nihon account-এর সাথে সম্পর্কিত profile, learning progress ও activity records মুছে দেওয়ার flow প্রদান করে, আইনগত বা নিরাপত্তাজনিত বাধ্যতামূলক retention প্রয়োজন না হলে।
entries.target: Habang aktibo ang account, maaaring panatilihin ang account-related data. Kapag dinelete ng user ang account, nagbibigay ang Aponar Nihon ng flow para burahin ang profile, learning progress at activity records na nauugnay sa account, maliban kung may legal o security na obligasyong retention.

entries.source: নিজের account এবং associated app data delete করতে
entries.target: Para burahin ang sarili mong account at associated app data

entries.source: ব্যবহার করুন। Logged-in user সরাসরি deletion confirm করতে পারবেন। এই page Play Store-এর external account-deletion URL হিসেবেও ব্যবহারযোগ্য।
entries.target: gamitin. Maaaring direktang kumpirmahin ng logged-in user ang deletion. Magagamit din ang page na ito bilang external account-deletion URL ng Play Store.

entries.source: Access control, authenticated sessions এবং database Row Level Security ব্যবহার করা হয়। তবুও internet-based service-এ absolute security guarantee করা যায় না।
entries.target: Ginagamit ang access control, authenticated sessions at database Row Level Security. Gayunpaman, hindi magagarantiya ang ganap na seguridad sa isang internet-based service.

entries.source: Aponar Nihon সাধারণ education service; এটি 13 বছরের কম বয়সী শিশুদের কাছ থেকে জেনে-বুঝে account data সংগ্রহের উদ্দেশ্যে তৈরি নয়।
entries.target: Ang Aponar Nihon ay isang pangkalahatang serbisyo sa edukasyon; hindi ito idinisenyo para sadyang mangolekta ng data ng account mula sa mga batang wala pang 13 taong gulang.

entries.source: Service বা legal requirement পরিবর্তিত হলে এই policy update হতে পারে। নতুন effective date এই page-এ দেখানো হবে।
entries.target: Maaaring ma-update ang policy na ito kapag nagbago ang service o legal requirement. Ipapakita sa page na ito ang bagong effective date.

entries.source: Privacy বা account-related প্রশ্নের জন্য Aponar Nihon website-এর Contact/Support option ব্যবহার করুন।
entries.target: Para sa mga tanong tungkol sa privacy o account, gamitin ang Contact/Support option sa Aponar Nihon website.
